identity.name: Potassium acetate
identity.chemical_class: Potassium salt of acetic acid (acetate salt)

function.mechanism: Weak-acid/acetate action supports pH control and antimicrobial preservation; also used for flavor adjustment in some formulations.

adi.basis: No final EFSA ADI published for E261 in the ongoing EFSA-Q-2011-00593 re-evaluation entry.

efsa.key_finding: Open EFSA states E261 is already authorised in the EU; re-evaluation is ongoing/planned (last modified 2026-01-17).

fda.notes: Listed as a permitted synthetic flavoring substance/adjuvant with minimum-use and GMP conditions; no dedicated potassium acetate GRAS listing found in 21 CFR parts 182/184.

adi.basis: ADI NOT LIMITED (group ADI for acetic acid and potassium/sodium salts), maintained at 49th meeting (1997).

concerns.summary: Recent potassium-acetate-associated food studies are primarily antimicrobial/shelf-life studies rather than long-term toxicology or epidemiology, leaving a modern evidence gap.

As a potassium salt, high total potassium intake is a theoretical concern for potassium-restricted individuals, although this was not demonstrated as an E261-specific dietary risk in the retrieved studies.

no_concern_confirmed: JECFA assigned a group ADI of NOT LIMITED for acetic acid and potassium/sodium salts.
No potassium acetate entry was found in the IARC classified agents dataset reviewed.

populations: No general-population numeric ADI exceedance assessment available (JECFA ADI is not limited).
People on potassium-restricted diets may need case-by-case caution at high cumulative potassium intake.
adi_exceedance.notes: EFSA's dedicated E261 re-evaluation output is still pending; JECFA uses a non-numeric ADI framework for this acetate group.

risk_assessment.rationale: Regulatory anchors are generally permissive (EU authorised status, US CFR listing, JECFA ADI not limited) and no IARC classification signal was found, but EFSA's dedicated re-evaluation remains ongoing and modern additive-specific long-term datasets are limited.
key_factors: EFSA question EFSA-Q-2011-00593 is ongoing/planned with no final output
21 CFR 172.515 allows use with GMP/minimum-use conditions
No IARC classification entry found for potassium acetate
Recent literature emphasizes food preservation efficacy more than chronic toxicity
